scripts.db:reset: bun run scripts/assert-non-production.ts db:reset && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 bunx prisma db push --schema ../schema.prisma --force-reset --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
scripts.db:seed: bun run scripts/assert-non-production.ts db:seed && bun run rbac:preflight && bun run scripts/demo-seed.ts
scripts.db:prepare: bun run db:reset && bun run db:seed
scripts.db:test:prepare: bun run scripts/assert-test-environment.ts db:test:prepare && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 bunx prisma db push --schema ../schema.prisma --force-reset --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && bun run scripts/demo-seed.ts
scripts.ci:preflight: bun run typecheck && bun run rbac:preflight
